name: xyz.pinner/mcp
title: Pinner MCP
description: Pinner.xyz MCP server: pin to IPFS, deploy websites, and manage vaults, DNS, and IPNS.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount a persistent volume so the SQLite vault cache and config survive redeploys. Root it at the PINNER_HOME directory.

volume_name.description: Name of the persistent Docker volume for Pinner state

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret accepted as a Bearer token (or the OAuth resource-owner password when MCP_OAUTH is enabled)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH
environmentVariables.description: Enable the OAuth 2.1 handshake for OAuth-expecting MCP clients (Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Copilot, Vertex)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public base URL advertised in OAuth discovery metadata. Set to the deployed public HTTPS URL

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CORS
environmentVariables.description: Enable CORS for browser-based MCP clients, reflecting the request Origin

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Local bind host for the HTTP transport

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind port (PaaS-universal). Mapped to MCP_PORT by the entrypoint when unset

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error
